w10_T4_001240: In the morning Cal picked 84 apples in the orchard, and before lunch he picked 66 more. In the afternoon he picked another 40, which was more than his friend Dee managed in her whole day. Cal picked exactly the same number of apples on each of 8 days. In the evening of the last day the orchard owner paid him 7 cents for every apple. How many cents did Cal earn?
w10_T4_001241: In the morning a farm's water tank received 9 deliveries of 186 litres each. A little later 78 litres were pumped in from a stream, and then 6 litres were added from a barrel. In the afternoon 140 litres were used to wash the barn, which took half an hour. In the evening the farmer bottled all the remaining water, getting 4 cups from every litre. How many cups did the farmer fill?
w10_T4_001242: A gardener bought 9 packets of bean seeds with 207 seeds in each packet. He divided the seeds equally among 3 plots. In the first plot every seed grew into a plant that gave 8 pods. He also picked 76 pods from a wild plant and added them to the first plot's harvest. Every pod held 7 beans. How many beans did the first plot's harvest give?
w10_T4_001244: A bakery bakes 163 rolls on each tray and puts 2 trays in every batch. Each batch is shared equally between its 2 shops. In the first shop every roll from the batch is cut into 2 pieces to sell as halves. The bakery bakes 5 batches a day, and it does this for 6 days. How many pieces does the first shop sell in those 6 days?
w10_T4_001247: In the morning a courier office had 186 minutes of deliveries, a little over three hours, which were shared equally between Ed and Flo. Before noon 12 minutes of deliveries were added to Ed's round. In the afternoon another 51 minutes were added to Ed's round, and Flo finished her own round sooner than Ed did. In the evening 13 minutes of Ed's deliveries were cancelled. How many minutes of deliveries did Ed end up with?
w10_T4_001249: Nia had 153 cents in her purse. She spent 91 cents on a bun and 43 cents on a sticker. Her friend Ivo, who had less money than Nia by the end, gave her 61 cents he owed her, so she had less than a dollar. Her mother then gave Nia 3 cents for every cent she had. How many cents does Nia have now?
w10_T4_001263: In the morning a soup kitchen served 67 bowls of soup, and then 35 more bowls as people kept arriving. At noon it ran a second sitting that served exactly as many bowls as the morning, making 2 sittings of the same size. In the afternoon 42 late arrivals were served, and in the evening another 66 people came for a bowl. The kitchen served exactly this number of bowls every day for 7 days. How many bowls of soup did it serve in total?
w10_T4_001269: Ren earns 183 cents an hour packing boxes, more per hour than his workmate Kip, and worked 8 hours on Saturday with a half-hour lunch break. He received a 15-cent tip from a customer. He spent 390 cents on lunch. Later he found 54 cents in his coat and was paid 62 cents he was owed. On the bus home he dropped 3 cents. How many cents does Ren have?
w10_T4_001271: Vic is paid 84 cents for every item he assembles. There are 6 items in a box, and he finished 4 boxes, which came to a little over twenty dollars. His boss added a 55-cent bonus. Vic spent 1866 cents on a pair of boots, and then earned 41 cents returning bottles. At the fair he received 2 tokens for every cent he had. How many tokens did Vic get?
w10_T4_001281: Zia earns 111 cents for every hour she works, but 81 cents of each hour's pay is withheld for her uniform. She gets a 27-cent tip every hour as well. She works 9 hours a day for 3 days. Her friend Yan earns less per hour than Zia. Zia's aunt then gives her 36 cents, and Zia spends 330 cents on a scarf. How many cents does Zia have now?
w10_T4_001283: A bag of 225 marbles was shared equally among 5 children. Nate gave 28 of his marbles to Bo, who then had more marbles than Nate. Nate's uncle then gave him 61 marbles. Nate put his marbles equally into 3 jars. Each marble weighs 5 grams. How many grams do the marbles in all 3 of Nate's jars weigh together?
w10_T4_001284: Ash gets 15 cents from his mother every day and 5 cents from his father every day, and he saves all of it. After 5 days he had exactly one dollar. He then spent 78 cents on a comic. His sister paid him back 12 cents. How many cents does Ash have now?
w10_T4_001289: Ola had 219 postcards. She bought 55 more at a flea market. Her album holds 40 postcards per page. She gave 64 postcards to her friend Pim, who still had fewer postcards than Ola afterwards. She then threw away 27 damaged postcards. A dealer paid her 7 cents for each postcard she had left, and added 17 cents for the box they came in. How many cents did the dealer pay Ola?
w10_T4_001290: Ada knits scarves faster than her friend Bel. Each of Ada's rows has 136 stitches, there are 8 rows in a band, and every scarf has 9 bands. She adds 9 finishing stitches to every scarf. She packs 9 scarves in each box, and she has 3 boxes to fill. How many stitches does Ada knit for the 3 boxes?
w10_T4_001291: A bread recipe uses 154 grams of flour, plus 36 grams of rye flour, but the baker takes out 13 grams of flour from every loaf to keep the dough soft, and lets it rest for half an hour. She bakes 9 loaves on a tray, 3 trays in each oven load, and runs 4 oven loads. She also uses 14 grams of flour to dust the counter. How many grams of flour does she use altogether?
w10_T4_001294: Tia had 84 coins in her video game and won 22 more. She checks her score twice a day. She spent 21 coins on a shield and reached level 12. At the end of the game every coin she has left is worth 9 points, and she earns a 36-point bonus for finishing. How many points does Tia score?
w10_T4_001299: Kit's weekly pocket money is 239 cents. Every week he also earns 65 cents for washing the car, spends 104 cents on a comic, and gets 26 cents back from returning bottles, which leaves a little over two dollars each week. He saves this amount every week for 8 weeks. His grandfather then gives him 22 cents. How many cents has Kit saved?
w10_T4_001303: In the morning a bakery had 152 buns, and the baker made 16 more, then another 8. In the afternoon a delivery brought 28 buns. In the evening half of the buns were sent to a shelter, and the rest were shared equally among the 3 staff members. How many buns did the staff member Lou take home?
w10_T4_001310: Jo had 14 cents. He spent 5 cents on a sweet. His aunt gave him 69 cents, a little over half a dollar. He split his money equally between himself and his sister, so there were 2 equal shares and he kept one. He then spent 19 cents on a pencil and 8 cents on an eraser. How many cents does Jo have left?
w10_T4_001312: A video editor is cutting a series. Each clip lasts 143 seconds, a little under two and a half minutes. There are 8 clips in each episode, 3 episodes on each disc, and the series fills 8 discs. She adds a 59-second credits sequence at the very end, after working on the series for a dozen days. How many seconds does the whole series run?
w10_T4_001316: In the morning a coach had 195 minutes booked for each training session, more than three hours, but cut 154 minutes from every session. She ran 4 sessions that morning. In the afternoon the time from the morning sessions was shared equally among 4 trainees to record on their cards. In the evening one trainee, Kay, noted that she would train exactly the same way on each of 3 days. How many minutes will Kay record for the 3 days?
w10_T4_001317: A quiz night has 56 tokens in each box, and the host opened 4 boxes. She found 55 more tokens in a drawer and 31 in a bag. The hall was booked for 3 hours. All the tokens were shared equally between the 2 teams. At the end of the night every token held by the red team was worth 5 points. How many points did the red team score?
w10_T4_001324: Uma had 195 minutes of talk time on her phone, more than three hours. The company added 18 bonus minutes. She made a 52-minute call to her mother and another 52-minute call to her aunt. Her friend Vic, who uses more minutes than Uma, called her for 69 minutes. Her phone is 3 years old. She then made a 29-minute call to the dentist. How many minutes of talk time does Uma have left?
w10_T4_001325: In the morning a well pumped 220 litres an hour, and a second pipe added 80 litres an hour. The pump ran 4 hours that morning. In the afternoon the farmer counted that 2 wells on the farm run exactly the same each day, and that the pumps ran this way for 9 days. Rain added 26 litres to the tank. In the evening the co-operative noted that 3 farms had collected exactly this amount each. How many litres did the 3 farms collect altogether?
w10_T4_001329: A theatre sold 237 tickets on Monday, 39 on Tuesday, 20 on Wednesday, 52 on Thursday, and 3 on Friday. The theatre has 8 exits. On Saturday 12 tickets were refunded. How many tickets were sold and not refunded?
